units.name: Fakultät Ingenieurwissenschaften und Informatik
units.evidence: Original German organization page supplies full faculty name. Official engineering exchange offerings and industrial engineering programme establish logistics, technical operations optimization and production planning/control work; degree itself not treated as a department.

units.name: Fakultät Wirtschaft und Recht
units.evidence: Official faculty organization page explicitly hosts Betriebswirtschaft. The opened program page describes production management and logistics teaching, purchasing and quality-management specialization. The faculty host is recorded as a school, without inventing a separate operations department.
